g.text: Chroma is only part of the gradient

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: Actual lightness and hue along three of the same ramps — these are values, not derivatives
Hue panels have different origins but equal degree spans. Hue is omitted near neutral (chroma < 0.0001).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: Encoded P3 HSL lightness is 0.5 throughout; that does not make Oklab lightness or hue constant.
